paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness - fork with an OpenHarmony port (branch: harmonyos); adaptation suite at shizhongga
- fork with an OpenHarmony port (branch: harmonyos); adaptation suite at shizhonggang/dsh-harmonyos
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
It uses an architecture where **everything is a plugin**, and is powered by Cordis, whose design is
described in _A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_.
DeepSeek Harness is currently in _developer preview_ and is iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPA
The command starts the Web UI, served at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default. See Web UI guide.
To run from a repository checkout:

- Feel free to submit feedback or bug reports through GitHub Discussions.
- Add the `dsh-plugin` top

ic to your plugin repository for discoverability.
- Join DeepSeek Harness Discord community.
Start with the development guide and architecture documentation.
Third-party dependencies and their licenses are disclosed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
